utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the wiring and a couple of busted outlets, from what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So we need someone to check the wiring and swap those outlets, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I’ve got a toolbox if you need it, and I can swing by to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds good. I might need that toolbox if I find the drive acting up again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring it by if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s picking up again this afternoon. Folks have been dropping off tools and a bit of cash all morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and I heard they’re still short on a good drill if anyone’s got a spare one to lend.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Just tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve still got the loose railing by the front steps and the fence latch in back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take care of those. I’ll head over and get the railing and latch fixed up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now, so if you can come by or send a hand, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by after dinner, but I may only be able to help for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll count on you after dinner. Even a short bit helps, and I’ll make sure there’s something useful for you to jump into.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’m keeping the repair drive organized, and I’ll make sure we have the list and next steps ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, keep me posted on the list and what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I will, Leo. I’ll send you the updated list soon and flag anything that still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing on the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, it’s mostly the loose rail in the front hall and the cracked step by the porch. I can point you to the rest when we meet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll look for the loose rail in the front hall and the cracked porch step when we meet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check our school pickup times and see what I can commit to.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps, Faye. Just let me know what you can take on once you check, and I’ll fit the drive plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check my pickup times and then tell you exactly what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard a little about it, but I’m still catching up. Is there anything I should know before I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just the basics: it’s about pitching in where you can, and folks are starting to organize tasks. I can fill you in on what I heard if you want.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure you can handle it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can handle it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you point me to where the repairs start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I think the repairs start by the old fence near the mailbox. I may be mixing that up, though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. I’ll check by the old fence near the mailbox first and see if the repair drive starts there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Let’s talk through what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got a few basics on hand, and I can tell you what’s still missing once we check the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, let’s check the list and I’ll help fill in whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up steam, so I’m keeping an eye out for anyone who needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can lend a hand if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That would be great, Rey. I’m going to keep checking in while I’m out, and I’ll let you know where you’d help most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to ask you about that earlier, but my mind slipped—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just the basics: maybe a drill bit set, some screws, and a step ladder if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can bring that over. I’ve got the basics somewhere, just need to find them and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think I heard something about that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can use a hand loading and unloading the repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can help with that. Just point me to the supplies and I’ll start loading.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand or a tool if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That'd be helpful, Gus. I’ll keep it simple and start with the basics.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good deal. I’ll grab the basic tools and we can work through it step by step.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, then I’ll send folks your way and let you know what’s left to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, send them my way, and I’ll keep an eye on what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon, and I’m happy to help connect folks if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, I can help. If you tell me where people are gathering, I’ll keep track of the spots.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll point people your way as I hear where they’re gathering.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the list started, and I can swing by to sort the repair drive details with you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll bring the supply list and we can sort out the repair drive details together.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll bring the list and we can make sure the repair drive is set up cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits about it, but I’m ready to help if there’s anything still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, can you take a look at the back fence? That’s the part I’m most worried about.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that. I’ll check the fence and let you know if it needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure - I can cover the pickup runs and still help with the drive. Just send me the details on what needs to be moved.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, send the pickup list and I’ll keep an eye out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Kira. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You mean the repair drive this weekend, right? What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, the weekend repair drive. Mostly small stuff: loose hinges, leaky faucets, and a few broken outlets.
